title: A road to Lisp: Why Lisp
summary: An article exploring the author's motivations for learning Lisp, discussing its unique features like homoiconicity, REPL-driven development, powerful macros, and the code-as-data philosophy that sets it apart from mainstream languages.
problem_solved: Explains why developers should consider learning Lisp in a world dominated by mainstream languages like Python and JavaScript.
why_valuable: Provides practical insights into Lisp's metaprogramming capabilities and REPL-driven workflow that enable unprecedented code flexibility and expressiveness.
